episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to founder-led sales | Jen Abel (co-founder of JJELLYFISH)
episodeTitle.zh: 创始人主导销售的终极指南 | 珍·阿贝尔（JJELLYFISH联合创始人）

guestBioOfficial.en: Jen Abel is the co-founder of JJELLYFISH, where she and her team have worked with over 300 early-stage founders to learn how to sell, do early customer discovery, and set up a repeatable sales motion on the way to their first $1M ARR. In our conversation, Jen shares: • Why founder-led sales is so crucial early on
guestBioOfficial.zh:
珍·阿贝尔（Jen Abel）是JJELLYFISH的联合创始人，她与团队合作，帮助300多位初创企业创始人学习如何销售、进行早期客户探索，并在迈向首个100万美元年度经常性收入（ARR）的道路上建立可重复的销售模式。在我们的对话中，珍分享了：  
• 创始人主导销售在早期为何如此关键

title.en: The ultimate guide to founder-led sales | Jen Abel (co-founder of JJELLYFISH)
title.zh: 创始人主导销售的终极指南 | 珍·阿贝尔（JJELLYFISH联合创始人）

summary.en: Jen gets extremely tactical on founder-led sales, treating the founder as the product and the goal as learning as fast as possible rather than revenue on day one. She covers how to craft counterintuitive, shock-value messaging that earns a read, how to structure the first sales call with vulnerability ('I'm early-stage, help me learn'), how to find and reach leads, get through procurement, and close. With actual words, phrases, and pitfalls at every step, it's an episode packed with advice you can put into practice tomorrow—the most hands-on sales conversation you'll find.
summary.zh: Jen 就“创始人式销售”给出极其具体的建议，把创始人本身当作产品，把目标定为“尽可能快地学习”而非第一天就要收入。她讲了如何写出反直觉、有冲击力的信息以赢得一读、如何在第一次销售电话中以坦诚示弱（“我们很早期，请帮我看看这个问题在你们那边是怎么发生的”）、如何找到并触达线索、通过采购流程并签约。每一步都附上真实话术、措辞与坑，这期节目充满了你明天就能用上的建议——是你所能找到最手把手的销售对话。
